Refresh, second tab, tab handoff, active worker stop and hidden timer retain the session without double-counting; repeated SPA and popstate handled in fixtures.
Explicit Pause Chrysalis suppresses automatic UI and time tracking.
Automatic-introduction preference respected; direct Shorts introduction works; Continue without timer does not create a session.
Native --restore-last-session restored a YouTube tab and automatically opened the new-browser introduction.

limitations: First-render timings include network/document arrival and browser/worker scheduling; not zero latency.
